name: MENT 5640
title: International Business
description: The growing impact of a rapidly changing international business environment on organizations today means that few managers can afford to remain indifferent to the issues of international business. It is important to understand the changing patterns of international business, the dynamics of international competition, government-business interactions in other countries, and the organizational challenges of managing strategically across borders. This course addresses these issues through an applied approach in the discussion of cases.
requirement_description: MENT 5138 or 5183, either of which may be taken concurrently; open to MBA students, others with consent.
